claims.text: A paradigm shift is underway in healthcare AI, transitioning from Pretrained Language Models to Large Language Models.
The paradigm shift in healthcare AI encompasses a move from discriminative AI approaches to generative AI approaches.
The paradigm shift in healthcare AI encompasses a move from model-centered methodologies to data-centered methodologies.
Fairness, accountability, transparency, and ethics represent the primary obstacles to using Large Language Models in Healthcare.

evidence.description: Summarily, we contend that a significant paradigm shift is underway, transitioning from PLMs to LLMs.
This shift encompasses a move from discriminative AI approaches to generative AI approaches...
...as well as a move from model-centered methodologies to data-centered methodologies.
We determine that the biggest obstacle of using LLMs in Healthcare are fairness, accountability, transparency and ethics.

methodologies.name: Literature survey and comparative analysis
methodologies.description: A survey outlining healthcare LLM capabilities and explicating their development roadmap, data, methods, applications, and ethical concerns relative to prior PLMs.

limitations.text: Healthcare LLM deployment is obstructed by issues regarding fairness, accountability, transparency, and ethics.
